# Playtest diary: r8-typed-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a retired schoolteacher who reads mysteries and has never played a computer game
- **Seed:** 78194
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 6caa60d
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 8
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-26/r8-typed-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

### Commands 0
 Starting out. I have never played one of these; the note says to type what I want to do. I am on "Deck Twelve" with a slot by a door. Mysteries teach you to look at everything first.

### Commands 1-45
 Looked at the slot, read the boxes in the Forms Storage Room, met Floyd in the Robot Pool (bin 3, via the robot form + "type 3"). Found a spacetruck in the Cargo Bay with a survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, thermos). The spacecraft form wants a course; the Assignment Completion form (paper viewer) has a time:course table - a lovely clue. First try: I left the hatch open, couldn't close it from the seat, and suffocated in space. Restarted, closed the hatch first, SAVED, typed 328 for time 5109. The truck flew to the station and stopped a few thousand meters off.

### Commands 46-90
 Docked at the station (+5). Ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt!); kept the blue soup and gray goo. Level Five: Workshop (took a twenty-ohm bedistor), dark Storage north of it, North Junction, Sick Bay (ID-reader security door, did nothing with my card), East Connection (iris hatch + slot to a Military Sub-Module), Comm Center (beacon button, blank screen), Station Control (monitors: Communication and Food Production RED, Printing YELLOW), Commander's Office (log reader), Commander's Quarters (8000-setting safe, log tape on desk). Hull welders keep stalking me "with excitement" - I dodge by changing rooms. The log tape was a wonderful mystery device: fuel cells locked in the Dome storage bin, key in the safe; validation STAMP hidden under the Commander's bed; alien pyramid moved to the Sci Sub-Module holding tank; Shady Dan in the village sells fake ID cards; equipment is going mad. Very good storytelling.

### Commands 91-150
 The log reader exploded after the last entry. Took the validation stamp from under the Commander's bed. Met Plato, a gentle poetry-reading robot who joins Floyd. Briefing Room, South Connection (closed iris hatch + slot), Robot Shop (sleeping robot Oliver; heating chamber - asked Floyd to fetch the medium drill bit since my hand won't fit, +3). File Room is dark. Level Four: barracks, SanFac, Docking Bay #3 (lilac nanofilm spool). Level Three: Gym (exercise machine; sign warns about frequency 710 broadcasts), Theatre (locked projection booth). Plato doesn't know much - "ask about" gives a stock reply.

### Commands 151-240
 Laundry (presser, empty dryer, washer missing). Chapel: puce spool; blinking star out of reach; the pulpit hides a switch that puts out the eternal flame (I put it back on). Mess Hall on Level Two: hot coffee but no people (spooky!); the food unit squirts ACID. Main Storage: a detonator with a blackened hyperdiode inside. Meeting Rooms 1-2, Library with a voice spool reader: puce = chapel maintenance ("...iode in the Chapel's star..." - so the star holds a hyperdiode for my detonator!), lilac = spacetruck fuel cell replacement with a "quarnum wrench". Both end with a demonic "You will die, human!". Then a welder killed me in the Library while I grabbed the spool. Restored to the Commander's Office save, redid stamp + drill bit, saved in Robot Shop. Standing on the pulpit fails (it sways). Dome at the top: locked, warm storage bin (the fuel cells), fixed air shaft grating.

### Commands 241-290
 Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks + SanFac (SanFac lists no exits; the way back is north), Officers' Quarters A/B/C with a shared SanFac, End of Corridor (security door with ID reader - my card does nothing; dark Shipping Room east). Docking Bay #1: the alien ship! Dots on the wall in groups (2 2 / 2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3 / 2 3 1 / 4 1 3 1 / 2 3 1) - I suspect the safe combination or a message. I searched the skeleton and it crumbled (oops). Pedestal empty (pyramid was moved to the Sci Sub-Module). Docking Bay #4 empty. Slept in Officers' Quarters B (+3); woke on Novem 5 with my things dropped by the bed, "take all" gathered them (and a funny bit about lifting Floyd).

### Commands 291-340
 Auto-doors now open sluggishly and slam early - things are getting worse on day 2. Level Seven: Printing Plant (mauve spool; trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form), Paper Recycling (a tired drill with one hole left). Ladder to Level Eight sealed from below; dread vibrations and a throbbing "mechanical heart" below. Drilled the safe: small bit = toothpick hole, restored and tried the medium bit = pencil hole; the safe still won't open (maybe the hole is for an explosive + my detonator?). Ironed the village form in the Laundry presser and STAMPED it - validated. Sci Sub-Module north of North Connection: Engineering Lab, Engineering Office (Schmidt's diary: the dots have NONVISUAL properties; "my pal the mayor" has linguistic training - the alien skeleton had an overdeveloped tongue case, so I think the dots are meant to be tasted/licked). Astro Lab: fromitz board.

### Commands 341-390
 Sci Sub-Module: Astro Lab (fromitz board), Astro Office, Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab, Bio Office (bloodstained note: "think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph..."), Holding Tank Level - tank BLASTED OPEN, pyramid gone. The PX vending machine sells an All-Purpose Timer and a Large Drill Bit (1 galakmid each; I have no coins). The Comm Center screen: the Duffy found its forms - abort and return (ha!). Put the validated village form in the East Connection slot: hatch half-opens (+6, score 17). Weightless connector into the village: Broadway, Recruitment Office, Field Office (HEADLAMP - finally a light, now worn and on), Grocery (plastic bag of vacuum taffy).

### Commands 391-400
 Village: Barbershop (old glass mirror), Trading Post (sign: FREZONE explosive available, "ask for it"; instruction sheet: put explosive in a hole of the right diameter, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep below 150 K). Twelve-prong fromitz board floating there. Down to a Warehouse with a closed door down marked VACUUM STORAGE - trespassers will be spaced. Leg budget spent here: score 17/80, Day 2 (Novem 5), time 3486. Saves kept: Commander's Quarters (after drilling setup), Laundry, East Connection (score 17).

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- **Duffy (start):** Deck Twelve (slot, port door closed) - aft Forms Storage; starboard Cargo Bay Entrance - fore Robot Pool, starboard Cargo Bay (spacetruck).
- **Station Level Five:** Lobby - W Docking Bay #2 (my truck), N Workshop - N Storage (dark; also W of North Connection). NE North Junction: N North Connection (N Tube to Sci Sub-Module; W dark Storage; E The PX), E Sick Bay (ID security door E) - SE East Connection (E = half-open hatch to village; S Comm Center; SW Station Control). SE South Junction: SW File Room (dark), E Station Control, SE Commander's Office (E Commander's Quarters with safe; S Briefing Room - W South Connection (closed iris hatch + slot to S) - W Robot Shop (Oliver)).
- **Ladder/elevator up:** L4 barracks + Docking Bay #3; L3 Gym (N), Theatre (S, locked booth), Laundry (NW, presser), Chapel (SW); L2 Mess Hall (N/S Main Storage, NE Meeting Room 1 - S Meeting Room 2 - S Library, SE Library); L1 Dome (locked warm storage bin, grating).
- **Down:** L6 Auxiliary Barracks/SanFac (N), Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac (S), End of Corridor (ID security door N, dark Shipping Room E), NW Docking Bay #1 (alien ship), SW Docking Bay #4. L7 Printing Plant + Paper Recycling (NW). L8 sealed from below.
- **Sci Sub-Module:** Tube - Engineering Lab (office N) / up Astro Lab (office N) / up Scientists' Quarters; down Bio Lab (office N) / down Holding Tank (blasted open).
- **Village (weightless):** E of East Connection: Makeshift Connector - Broadway: N Recruitment Office, E Field Office, S Grocery (E Barbershop, S Trading Post - down Warehouse (vacuum storage door down, SW opening)). Unvisited: many Broadway/Trading Post exits.

### Puzzles solved
- Floyd from the robot pool (robot form, type 3). Spacetruck: close hatch BEFORE launch, sit, insert spacecraft form, type course from the Assignment form table for the current time (+5 at docking).
- Log tape in the Commander's Office reader (push red button repeatedly); stamp under the Commander's bed.
- Medium drill bit: FLOYD, TAKE DRILL BIT from the heating chamber (+3). Sleep in a bed (+3).
- Village form: trash can on L7, iron in Laundry presser (turn on, wait, off), stamp, insert in East Connection slot (+6).
- Drilled a pencil-diameter hole in the safe with the medium bit (drill now spent).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Safe:** FREZONE explosive (Trading Post) into the pencil hole + detonator (needs a new hyperdiode - the Chapel star's blinking diode, out of reach) + All-Purpose Timer (PX, 1 galakmid). Keep explosive cold - the Thermos? Safe holds the key to the Dome bin with fuel cells.
- **Chapel star** too high; pulpit sways. Need something to stand on / a tall helper.
- **Alien dots:** Schmidt says nonvisual; skeleton had overdeveloped tongue case - try TASTE/LICK dots. "My pal the mayor" (village) can translate.
- Money: need galakmids for the PX machine.
- ID security doors (Sick Bay, L6 End of Corridor): card is rejected - Shady Dan sells modified ID cards.
- Pyramid escaped; station machinery turning murderous (welders, acid food unit, doors, spool readers saying "You will die, human!"). Level Eight sealed.
- Items unused: bedistor, 20-prong fromitz board (12-prong one left floating in the Trading Post), spools (mauve unread), vacuum taffy, headlamp (on).

### What I would try next
Ask around the Trading Post for FREZONE (find a shopkeeper), explore rest of village for Shady Dan and the mayor, find coins, read the mauve spool, taste the dots in the alien ship. Flee welders at once when "almost upon you"; SAVE often (undo is off).

## Leg 2

### Commands 1-25
 New leg, standing in the village Warehouse. SW to an Alley, NW up to Main Street (up/NE/S/W exits). West: Travel Agency; SE of it the Bank with a floating platinum detector (took it, switched it on; no reading yet). Up from Main Street: the Mayor's Office with "Deciphering Alien Speech" - a paper fluttered out with a taste glossary (bttr/salty/sour/sweet/blnd/spicy-hot combos to words). So the ship dots really are tastes! Saved there. NE: Greasy Straw restaurant, NE again the Trading Post; east of it a Saloon (disguised exit east) and a Casino with loaded zero-gee dice (roll = 11) and a roulette wheel. Hands are full - dropped the textbook in the Casino.

### Commands 26-60
 Grocery NW of the Saloon - Welder 3 came at me, fled south. SE of the Trading Post: Shady Dan's office with a jerry-built machine; turned it on, slotted my ID card: "rank 6 Lieutenant First Class, enter new rank" - typed 9 = HyperAdmiral! Down from Dan's: Junk Yard (a "Studio" description flashed first, a joke I think), magnetic spaceboots in the junk - the game warned they'd wipe my card, so I left them. Headlamp dimming; switched it off in lit rooms. Back to the station: the card opens the Sick Bay door (Brig: 3 locked empty cells; detector "getting warm" there) and the L6 End of Corridor door: Armory, +5 (score 22), fusor-beam zapgun with 7 charges. Drank the blue soup (hungry).

### Commands 61-95
 Shipping Room (east of End of Corridor, needs light): pallets of form boxes, sign "always return the forklift" - but no forklift. So something tall-ish went missing. Alien Ship: TASTE DOTS worked! My translation with the Mayor's glossary: "Hunji brethren: sabotage failed. However, I have shone light upon the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78 [platinum]! Turn back the deadly radiations. The atmosphere is souring." So platinum defeats the pyramid. The detector said "getting warm"/"very warm" in Brig and ship, then nothing more - unclear what it means; turned it off. Doors now "almost nipping your heels". Library: mauve spool = collator maintenance, "first check the lower fromitz ... replace with ..." then "You will die, human!". I have a 20-prong fromitz board; the 12-prong one floats in the Trading Post.

### Commands 96-130
 Chapel star: Plato "were I several meters taller"; Floyd wants to play. Still no way up. Printing Plant has no "collator" word; Paper Recycling nothing new; clanging from Level Eight below. Went to the village: Welder 1 on Broadway - ZAPGUN vaporised it (charge used). Opened the Vacuum Storage door in the Warehouse: an Airlock below ("secure all open containers before depressurization"). Closed the upper door, opened the lower one, and my lungs ruptured - died. Restored the Warehouse save (score 22). I need a spacesuit or some other protection.

### Commands 131-175
 More village: Barbershop (NW = Broadway), Fortune Teller below Broadway (crystal ball: fortune-telling tips, a joke), Rec Shop NE (simulation booth - a treasure hunt in an underground empire, sweet nod), Pet Store SW of Broadway: an Arcturian balloon creature on a leash. Opened its cage but every grab ends with it farting in my face and me dropping the leash; the game hinted "it would behave differently somewhere with gravity" - but how to get it there? Studio west of the Trading Post (the "Junk Yard"/"Studio" swap-joke again): scrap sculpture holds a J-series HYPERDIODE. Swapped it into the detonator for the blackened one. Floyd took my 20-prong board. Plato keeps calling me a "simpleton human" - is he turning nasty?

### Commands 176-240
 SPIN WHEEL in the Casino opened exits (+4, score 26): north an Opium Den (defaced anti-drug poster), up a Flophouse with a locker holding a SPACE SUIT. Had to drop kit/form/bag to wear it (weight). Airlock again in the suit: blown out into space, died. Magnetic boots needed! Stashed my HyperAdmiral card in the Flophouse locker, wore the boots from the Junk Yard, saved there. Then the twist: in the Warehouse PLATO stunned me with a stun ray and gave a villain's speech - the Zeenak pyramid turns machines against their makers and builds replicas; it killed everyone. I told Floyd to shoot Plato; Floyd just panicked and fled; Plato killed me. I suspected Plato ("simpleton human")! Restored Junk Yard; shooting Plato first - he dodges (zapgun now 5). Can't eat in the suit.

### Commands 241-280
 Second try: no ambush this time. Airlock with suit + boots: "In Space" vac yard (+3, score 29), found the FREZONE explosive cylinder by headlamp; put it in the Thermos and closed it (sign: secure open containers). Saved in the Airlock. Took off the suit, ate the taffy (boysenberry), dropped suit and boots in the Warehouse. Headlamp died (I forgot to switch it off). Retrieved my card from the Flophouse locker and the Assignment form. Now I need the All-Purpose Timer from the PX, which costs a galakmid - off to search the Bank.

### Commands 281-305
 Bank: nothing ("bank" and "vault" aren't known words). Greasy Straw smells mouth-watering - and there Plato ambushed me again. This time I said "Floyd, help me" (he dithered), "Floyd, take zapgun" (panic), then "Floyd, attack Plato": Floyd leapt, knocked the stun gun away, Plato landed on it and blew apart (+7, score 36). Floyd is sobbing on the floor and wants to be left alone. Poor dear. Behind the counter: a cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar. Saved in the Greasy Straw (Floyd's "Oh boy, something dangerous?" save quip rings odd while he sobs).

### Commands 306-345
 Travel Agency posters: nothing. Took the Fire Nectar. Walked to the PX: screen lists 6 All-Purpose Timer, 9 Large Drill Bit, rest sold out; typing 6 says "You have not deposited a coin". Kicking does nothing. Meanwhile the explosive in the Thermos softened then melted (Broadway ~7534 "softer", ~7723 "melting") and I got weary. Barracks cubicles: only personal items. Alien ship: nothing under the pedestal; then the game told me it could no longer be won (explosive gone). Restored the Greasy Straw save (score 36, time 7366). New plan: put the explosive back in the vac yard and hunt for a galakmid first.

### Commands 346-380
 Restored at the Greasy Straw, went straight to the Warehouse, had to drop zapgun/detector/bag to wear the suit (weight again). In the dark vac yard "take explosive" failed (too dark, headlamp dead) but "drop explosive" worked out of the open Thermos - I hope it stays tethered. Back up, saved in the Warehouse (score 36). Slept in the Flophouse bed: Resida plague nightmare, woke Novem 6. No points for sleeping this time. My chronometer has STOPPED (so the status line no longer shows time), and Floyd is kicking my mattress, swearing ("kripping") - he's being turned too, I fear. Saved in the Flophouse.

### Commands 381-400
 Searched for a coin: Flophouse bed (nothing), Casino tables/Saloon bar/Grocery shelves (not searchable or "bar" unknown), Recruitment Office (posters only). Broadway has no up/northwest. Back to the station, hungry again. Gym: the sign's exercise machine is GONE (frequency 710 warning). Floyd stomped on my foot - he's turning. Leg spent in the Gym, score 36/80, Novem 6 (chronometer stopped).

## Leg 2 handoff

### Map additions (see leg 1 map for the station)
- **Village:** Broadway: N Recruitment Office, E Field Office, S Grocery, SE Barbershop (NW back), NE Rec Shop (simulation booth), SW Pet Store (balloon creature, SE to Trading Post), down Fortune Teller (crystal ball), W Makeshift Connector to the station. Grocery: E Barbershop, S Trading Post, SE Saloon. Trading Post: N Grocery, NW Pet Store, E Saloon, SW Greasy Straw, SE Shady Dan's (down Junk Yard, W Alley), W Studio (sculpture), down Warehouse (down Airlock - down "In Space" vac yard; SW Alley). Saloon: E Casino (after SPIN WHEEL: N Opium Den, up Flophouse with locker/beds). Greasy Straw: SW Main Street (up Mayor's Office, W Travel Agency - SE Bank - N Main Street; SE ramp to Alley).
- **Station:** Sick Bay E (card) = Brig; L6 End of Corridor N (card) = Armory, E = Shipping Room (dark; forklift sign).

### Puzzles solved this leg
- Shady Dan's machine: turn on, put ID card in slot, TYPE 9 (HyperAdmiral) - opens the security doors (Armory +5).
- Spin roulette wheel (+4): Opium Den + Flophouse (space suit in locker).
- Vac yard: wear suit AND magnetic boots (leave the ID card behind - boots wipe it), close upper door, open lower, down (+3). FREZONE explosive there. It melts in ~25 moves even in the closed Thermos.
- Detonator: replaced blackened hyperdiode with the J-series one from the Studio sculpture.
- Taste dots in the alien ship + Mayor's glossary = platinum (element 78) is the pyramid's weakness.
- Plato's ambush (stun ray, villain speech): "Floyd, help me", then "Floyd, attack Plato" -> Floyd knocks the gun away, Plato blown up (+7).

### Where things are now (Flophouse save, score 36, Novem 6)
- Carrying: detonator (new diode), Thermos (empty, open?), zapgun (5 charges), platinum detector, glossary paper, plastic bag (20-ohm bedistor). Wearing headlamp (DEAD), uniform with HyperAdmiral card, stopped chronometer.
- Explosive dropped in the vac yard (not verified it stayed). Suit + boots + Assignment form in the Warehouse. Survival kit (stamp, instruction sheet, puce spool) in the Flophouse. Mauve spool in the Library reader. Dice + textbook in the Casino. Fire Nectar behind the Greasy Straw counter.
- Saves: Warehouse (score 36, day 2, explosive already parked), Flophouse (36, day 3) and Greasy Straw (36, day 2, explosive in hand, softening).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Galakmid coin** for the PX timer (item 6): not found anywhere yet. Not searched: Laundry dryer/presser, Officers' Quarters, Commander's things, Theatre, Main Storage, dark Storage rooms and File Room (need light - headlamp dead).
- **Safe:** explosive in the pencil hole + detonator + timer, set timer, leave. Plan the trip so the explosive leaves the vac yard only when the timer is in hand (it melts in ~25 moves).
- **Balloon creature:** "would behave differently somewhere with gravity" - can't hold its leash in zero-gee. Maybe it can lift me to the Chapel star (the star's diode is no longer needed).
- **Exercise machine** vanished from the Gym (frequency 710 diagnostics) - perhaps a platinum detector or something else broadcasts on 710? Maybe the machine walked off to Level Eight.
- Level Eight is sealed; clanging below - the pyramid's replica factory. Platinum is the weapon.
- Floyd is being corrupted (swearing, stomping).
- Hunger again; coffee in the Mess Hall, Fire Nectar at the Greasy Straw.

### What I would try next
Drink the coffee, find light (batteries?), search the Laundry dryer and the officers' rooms for a coin, get the timer, then fetch the explosive and blow the safe for the Dome bin key.

## Leg 3

- Start: Gym, score 36, Novem 6 (chronometer stopped). Budget 400 commands this leg (700 left of the cap).

### Commands 1-35
 Dryer empty. Brig: detector silent now (I suspect earlier "warm" was PLATO walking beside me - Plat-o, platinum?). Grew ravenous, went to the Mess Hall, drank the coffee: POISONED, died. Should have suspected it - the station is murderous now. Restored the Flophouse save. Opium Den poster: nothing. Zapped Welder 3 in the Greasy Straw (zapgun 4 left). Took the Fire Nectar. Bank: nothing searchable. Still no galakmid coin.

### Commands 36-65
 Balloon creature: Floyd frightened it; grabbing the leash still = fart + drop everything. Simulation booth: a torrid romance on San Cupidor (cute). Grocery shelves, junk: nothing. Back at the station, saved at East Connection and drank the Fire Nectar (safe - "yummy", cured hunger). "ask floyd about coin" says "Those things aren't here!" - so a coin object exists somewhere. Commander's desk/cubicles: personal items only.

### Commands 66-100
 Surprise: the South Connection iris hatch is now open - a Grimy Passage south leads straight to Main Street in the village (shortcut; Main Street doesn't list "north"). Oliver still "sleeping" (2-20 day incubation). Mayor's Office empty, crystal ball = fortune-teller tips, Trading Post has no more exits, headlamp truly dead. Theatre projection booth: locked. Chapel pulpit: only the flame switch. Still no coin. Trying the platinum detector as a coin-finder next (galakmids might be platinum?).

### Commands 101-125
 Detector: no reaction in the Alien Ship or anywhere now. Officers' quarters beds, SanFac tubs: nothing. Spacetruck: the SB radio turns on but only hisses; microphone missing; can't tune it to 710 ("demented Denebian slime devil"). I am going in circles hunting a single coin. Mystery-reader instinct: the one thing the station misses is the washer (Laundry) and the exercise machine (Gym) - machines that walked away. Maybe the coin is with a robot.

### Commands 126-155
 PX: slot and hole show blackness; reaching in finds nothing; "Why attack a dispenser?". Zapped Welder 2 (zapgun ~3 left). Scientists' Quarters/Astro Office: personal items. Detector said "getting warm" again with nothing around - I now think it just heats up after being on a while (turned off). Printing machinery "outside your expertise". Trash can empty. Tried the elevator from Level Seven: it had full gravity in the shaft (a warning I ignored) and typing 8 sent it into a power dive - dead. Restored East Connection (before the nectar; I still hold it).

### Commands 156-185
 Theory: wear the space suit to hold the balloon leash without smelling it - the glove is too clumsy (nicely anticipated). "hold breath" unknown. Then I finally tried the Alley's "dark passages": SOUTH = a Loan Shark's vessel with a strong box with a HUGE lock. Zapped the lock: box vaporized leaving ONE GALAKMID coin (+5, score 41)! Saved at the Loan Shark (replaced the old Warehouse save). Lesson: try every direction when a room says "passages in almost every direction".

### Commands 186-205
 More Alley rooms: Pawn Shop (spray can "E-Z SPRAY SPORZ ... lowest gas-inducement levels" - food for the balloon creature, less farting!), "Doc" Schuster's (disposal-chute hole; an OSTRICH nearly 3 m tall - could reach the chapel star?; letter: ostrich nip is in "my ceiling panel"). Walked to the PX via the Grimy Passage shortcut, coin in, typed 6: "klunk", timer stuck; I can feel it with fingertips. Kicking vents aggression only. Floyd (small hands) is not with me; a welder came, I fled.

### Commands 206-240
 Took the magnetic boots to the PX (left my card in the Warehouse so they couldn't wipe it) and shoved them up the hole - they just drop out. Shaking/kicking: no. Oliver can't wake until incubation ends. Floyd has vanished - no longer follows me, even after restoring the Loan Shark save (he stayed behind). Re-took the spray can and letter; heading to the Pet Store to feed the balloon and look for a ceiling panel.

### Commands 241-270
 Pet Store: EXAMINE CEILING revealed a panel with a stick of OSTRICH NIP (+3, 44). Spraying spores made the balloon creature dart about mouth open, but grabbing the leash still ends in a fart. The ostrich followed the nip's scent from Doc's all the way into the station (belly-flop into gravity - ha). PX: coin in, 6, klunk; PUT NIP IN HOLE - the ostrich stuck its head up after it, the timer fell out (+6, score 50), and the ostrich got drunk on the nip. Lovely. Saved at the PX with the timer (0-100, one connection point).
 Worry: the explosive lies in the DARK vac yard and my headlamp is dead; last time "take explosive" failed in the dark. I need a light.

### Commands 271-290
 Space suit: "totally ordinary" (no helmet lamp). Field Office: no more lamps. Went anyway: dropped card/timer/detonator etc. in the Warehouse, wore suit + boots, closed the Thermos, cycled the airlock. In Space: pitch black (grue joke), "take explosive" = too dark; "feel around" not understood. Leg budget spent here, still in the vac yard, score 50.

## Leg 3 handoff

### Map additions
- **Alley** (SW of Warehouse, SE of Main Street): S Loan Shark (strong box - vaporized), SW Pawn Shop (spray can), SE "Doc" Schuster's (ostrich; disposal-chute hole), E Junk Yard, NE Warehouse, NW up to Main Street. Unlisted exits! Try every direction.
- **Grimy Passage:** South Connection's iris hatch is now open (day 3): S from South Connection -> Grimy Passage -> Main Street (Main Street's "north" isn't listed). Fast station<->village route.
- Pet Store ceiling panel (EXAMINE CEILING).

### Puzzles solved this leg
- Coin: Alley S -> Loan Shark, SHOOT LOCK WITH ZAPGUN -> galakmid (+5).
- Ostrich nip: letter at Doc's -> EXAMINE CEILING in the Pet Store, open panel, take nip (+3).
- Timer: ostrich follows the nip scent; lead it to the PX, coin in slot, TYPE 6 (klunk, stuck), PUT NIP IN HOLE -> timer drops (+6, score 50).
- Fire Nectar is safe to drink (cures hunger). Mess Hall COFFEE IS POISONED. Elevator: typing 8 = fatal power dive.

### State now (score 50, Novem 6, chronometer stopped)
- In Space (vac yard), wearing suit + magnetic boots + dead headlamp, holding closed empty Thermos. Explosive is somewhere here in the dark.
- Warehouse: ID card, zapgun (~3-4 charges), detonator (new diode), timer, glossary paper, bag+bedistor, spray can, letter, detector, 20-prong board, Assignment form.
- Saves: Loan Shark (41, coin in hand), PX (44, before coin), PX (50, timer in hand - best restore point). Floyd has gone off on his own (corrupted?); does not follow.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Light** for the dark vac yard: headlamp dead. Candidates: dark Storage rooms, File Room, the chapel's flame, batteries somewhere? Or try other verbs in the dark ("take all", "drop thermos" then "take cylinder", "search").
- **Safe:** explosive (keep cold - Thermos, melts ~25 moves) in pencil hole, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, leave. Route vac yard -> safe is ~12 moves via Alley/Main Street/Grimy Passage.
- Balloon creature: sporz spray didn't stop the fart in zero-gee; needs gravity. Ostrich could maybe reach the chapel star (it's lying drunk in the PX now).
- Floyd's whereabouts; Oliver's incubation; Theatre projection booth locked; Level Eight (pyramid factory) sealed; platinum is the pyramid's weakness.

### What I would try next
Restore the PX (50) save. Hunt for a light (Storage/File Room need light themselves - look for batteries, a flashlight in the Workshop/Shipping Room, or the flame). Then fetch the explosive, and blow the safe.

## Leg 4

- Start: In Space (vac yard), score 50, dark. Budget this leg: 300 commands (rest of the 1500 cap).

### Commands 1-22
 In the dark vac yard "take all" = too dark. Restored the PX save (score 50, timer in hand; explosive parked in the vac yard). Headlamp: "seems to be dead". Zapped Welder 4 in the Workshop (machinery "outside your expertise"). Field Office search: nothing. New Alley exit NORTH: a Missionary kook's home (empty). Main Street south = the Bank. Pawn Shop: nothing new ("balls" unknown). Still hunting a light for the vac yard.

### Commands 23-50
 Walked to the Chapel: star "beyond your reach", throwing the spray can at it misses. Ostrich in the PX still drunk. The dark Storage west of North Connection: pitch black, "turn on light" only tries my dead headlamp; can't open the headlamp. I realise the save seems to be ONE slot (restore brought back only the last save), so no older save with a live lamp. Getting hungry again. Next idea: an opium den should have a LAMP - going to look.

### Commands 51-100
 Opium Den: nothing; "spotlight" in the Casino is an unknown word. Flophouse locker empty; the gray goo is gone from the kit. Greasy Straw: no more food. Rec Shop booth is flavour. BREAKTHROUGH: the balloon creature follows sprayed spores like the ostrich followed the nip! Spray on Broadway, connector, East Connection - it enters gravity, and TAKE LEASH lifts me two metres to the ceiling (can't walk while hanging; DROP LEASH to come down). Lured it by spraying room by room up the ladder to the Chapel - but it balks at the doorway: the hydrogen creature fears the eternal flame. Went for the pulpit switch and collapsed from hunger - died. Plan: restore the PX save, and do it fast: Pet Store, spray-lure to the Chapel, put out the flame (pulpit switch), lure in, take leash, take star (light + hyperdiode?).

### Commands 101-150
 Died of hunger, restored PX, and did the balloon run cleanly: Pet Store -> spray room by room -> Chapel; OPEN PULPIT, TURN OFF SWITCH (flame out), spray to lure it in, TAKE LEASH (lifted 2 m), TAKE STAR: +7, score 57! Saved (the save replaced "the oldest of three kept" - so there ARE three slots; plain RESTORE takes the newest). Hoped the blinking star would light the vac yard: no - pitch black still; OPEN STAR reveals an M-series hyperdiode (my detonator has the J-series from the sculpture - maybe the wrong kind?). Back in the Warehouse, still lightless and hungry.

### Commands 151-190
 Took stock in the Warehouse (detonator "two connection points, a faint crack - can be opened"). Theatre projection booth needs a key ("Your nose is key-shaped, I suppose?"). Main Storage: organic materials inedible. The food unit still squirts acid ("chicken pot pie" menu - cruel joke). ZAPGUN on the safe: glows, cools (footnote joke). "water" is unknown in the Commander's SanFac. Spacetruck: empty. I'm ravenous with no food left anywhere I know; I suspect the food supply is simply exhausted and I'm near the end of my days on this station.

### Commands 191-225
 Opened the detonator: J-series diode inside; both diodes "nothing special". Restored the Chapel save (57). While hanging from the balloon, TAKE FLAME = "Nice try." Bedistor won't go in the headlamp. Crystal ball: can be taken, only the fortune-teller tips, waving hands does nothing. Last idea for light: fire the zapgun in the dark vac yard and hope its glow shows the cylinder.

### Commands 226-262
 Zapgun in the vac yard: "Nasty flames spew", still pitch black. Restored the Chapel save. Re-heard the mauve spool (collater maintenance) - but the Printing Plant knows neither "collator" nor "collater"; Level Eight still sealed from below. Oliver still incubating. Heating chamber just sterilises tools. Trying the dark File Room next.
 File Room: pitch black. The harness reports the 1500-command cap reached here (score 57, Novem 6, standing in the dark File Room).

## Leg 4 handoff (final - cap reached)

### Map additions
- Alley NORTH = Missionary (flavour only). Main Street SOUTH = Bank. Otherwise the leg 1-3 maps stand.

### Puzzles solved this leg
- **Balloon creature / Chapel star (+7):** SPRAY CAN (sporz) in the next room lures the creature room by room (like the ostrich and the nip). In gravity TAKE LEASH lifts you 2 m (can't walk; DROP LEASH to come down). It refuses the Chapel while the flame burns: OPEN PULPIT, TURN OFF SWITCH, spray, TAKE LEASH, TAKE STAR. The star opens to an M-series hyperdiode. It does NOT light dark rooms.
- The save keeps THREE slots; plain RESTORE takes the newest.

### State (newest save: Chapel, score 57, day 3)
- Carrying star, timer, letter, spray can, bag+bedistor, glossary paper, Thermos (open), detonator (J-series diode), zapgun (~3 charges). Card in uniform. Headlamp dead, chronometer stopped. Suit, boots, detector, 20-prong board, Assignment form in the Warehouse. Explosive lies in the dark vac yard. Balloon creature in the Chapel, flame off.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Light** is the blocker: vac yard, File Room and Storage are dark; the headlamp is dead; star, zapgun flames, crystal ball, eternal flame (can't be taken) all failed. I suspect the game may be lost since the lamp died, but the game hasn't said so.
- **Food:** none left that I know of (coffee poisoned, food unit squirts acid). The hunger clock kills about 70 commands after a restore.
- The safe (explosive + detonator + timer), the Dome bin (fuel cells), the Theatre booth (needs a key), Level Eight (sealed), Oliver (incubating), platinum vs the pyramid: all untouched.

### What I would try next
If a replay is allowed: switch the headlamp off every time you are in a lit room, get the explosive while the lamp still works, and blow the safe straight away with the timer in hand. From here: look for batteries or a lamp in unsearched corners (Barbershop, Studio, Travel Agency, the Sci Sub-Module labs).

# Playtest diary: r8-click-fullA

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a teenager who plays mobile puzzle games and skims text
- **Seed:** 18829
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 6caa60d
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 8
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-26/r8-click-fullA.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)


### Commands 0
Starting. I'm a teen who skims — I'll mostly tap stuff and hope. Game says I'm on Deck Twelve with forms. Door to port with a slot. Guessing the ID card goes in the slot? (I vaguely remember Planetfall had card slots, but not this one.)

### Commands 1-24
Found the Forms Storage (just boxes), Cargo Bay with a spacetruck, and a survival kit inside it (took it). Putting the activation form in the truck slot got it spat back: both seats must be filled — nice clear hint. Robot Pool is fore of the cargo entrance; put the robot form in the slot, and the marbles bot turned out to be Floyd (I sort of know Floyd from Planetfall by reputation). Typed 3 and he joined. Sat in the pilot seat, Floyd took the copilot seat, the form was accepted. The course table on the Assignment form (time→course): the time was 5439, so 247. "Course set." The hatch is still open and I can't reach it from the seat — worried.

### Commands 25-46
Died when the truck launched with the hatch open — no save, restarted. Second run: got Floyd again, closed the hatch before sitting, saved, time 5111 → course 328, and it launched. The kit has orange goo, gray goo, and a thermos. Waiting through the flight ate a lot of the hunger timer (about 35 moves per wait). Docked at bay two: +5, score 5. Nobody is there to meet me, "odd". Ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt). Now I'm going out to explore.

### Commands 47-66
Station exploring. Level Five lobby (elevator east, ladder up and down). Workshop north (took a twenty-ohm bedistor), then Storage beyond it, which is pitch black (need a light). North Junction → Sick Bay (the security door's ID reader rejects my card: "Nothing happens") → East Connection (iris hatch with a slot, military sub-module) → Comm Center (big red beacon button, blank screen; not pushed yet). Station Control: the monitor board shows COMMUNICATION and FOOD red, PRINTING yellow. Commander's Office: log reader, no tape, fixed down. Briefing Room. South Connection (another iris hatch and slot). Robot Shop: Oliver, an unborn robot, plus a heating chamber holding a medium drill bit that is too small for a human hand. Theory: Floyd's small hand? Floyd wandered off somewhere.

### Commands 67-92
Floyd brought Plato (a library robot). Told Floyd to take the drill bit from the heating chamber: +3 (score 8). South Junction → File Room (dark). East Junction. PX: a vending machine for 1 galakmid; only the All-Purpose Timer (6) and the Large Drill Bit (9) are in stock, and I have no coin. North Connection → Tube → Scientific Sub-Module: Engineering Lab (mid), Engineering Office (Schmidt's diary: a pyramid over a billion years old from an alien ship; the wall dots have "nonvisual properties"; "my pal, the mayor" has linguistic training), Astro Lab (took a twenty-prong fromitz board), Astro Office (desk, nothing). Both office desks hold only "personal items".

### Commands 93-122
Scientists' Quarters (top of the sub-module), Bio Lab, Bio Office (a bloody note: "think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph..." — spooky), Holding Tank Level (the tank has been blasted open and is empty). Back to Level Five, then up the ladder to Level Four: Female and Male Barracks (cubicle exits are all "nothing of interest"), SanFac between them, Docking Bay #3 (took a lilac nanofilm spool). The thermos holds blue soup. Carrying too much ("a take may fumble"), so I dropped the diary and note in Bay 3. Sleepy in ~60 moves — I'll sleep in a barracks bed when it's time.

### Commands 123-152
Level Three: Gym (the exercise machine sign says don't bring anything broadcasting on frequency 710 near it), Theatre (the projection booth has an "ordinary lock"), Laundry (the washer is missing; there's a presser, which is closed and off, and an empty dryer), Chapel (took a puce nanofilm spool; the pulpit hides a switch that turns the eternal flame off and on — I left it on; the star is blinking). Saved, then slept in the Female Barracks: +3 (score 11). A dream about Resida. I woke on day 2 with everything dropped; Take all got it all back. Hungry in ~56.

### Commands 153-182
Up to Level Two, the Mess Hall. The food unit sprayed ACID at me instead of breakfast (the machines are turning evil?). A cup of coffee sits on a table, untouched. Main Storage (N and S both lead there): took a detonator, opened it, and found a blackened hyperdiode. Meeting Rooms 1 and 2 are empty. Library: the nanofilm reader plays the spools, then goes "You will die, human!". Lilac spool = spacetruck fuel cells with a quarnum wrench. Puce spool = chapel: flame fuel reservoir, "...iode in the Chapel's star". So the star's diode could replace the blackened one! Dome on top: a garden, a locked bin ("Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies"), an air shaft grating. Ate the gray goo. Next: Chapel star.

### Commands 183-214
The Chapel star is "beyond your reach". Climbing the pulpit makes it sway and I fall off. Floyd: "Floyd shorter even than you!" Plato: "were I several meters taller". Open puzzle — maybe low gravity, or something to stand on. Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks and SanFac, Officers' Quarters A/B/C plus a SanFac (all "personal items"), End of Corridor (another security door with an ID reader), Shipping Room east (dark). Docking Bay #1 NW: an ALIEN SHIP with its hatch open! The PA says a deep-space message came in at the Comm Center. The auto-doors are getting "sluggish" — the station is decaying.

### Commands 215-246
Alien ship: a skeleton with a huge tongue case; the pedestal is empty. TASTE DOTS gives a flavour-coded message — I need the "mayor" (Schmidt's pal) to translate it. Level Six SW: Docking Bay #4 (empty). A hull welder (#4, and later #1) is "moving purposefully toward you... excitement?" — scary, but it wandered off. Level Seven Printing Plant: from the trash can, a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q (not validated); took a mauve spool. Paper Recycling NW: took a DRILL with a small bit (dropped the fromitz board there). The ladder to Level 8 is sealed from below, and the elevator won't go to 8. Saved at Paper Recycling. Comm Center message: "Abort assignment and return to Duffy" lol.

### Commands 247-275
The crumpled form won't go into the East Connection slot ("crumpledness"), so I ironed it in the Laundry presser. The drill can't beat the theatre lock with either the small or the medium bit ("point not as hard as the lock") — I probably need the Large Drill Bit from the PX, which needs a coin. The ironed form was rejected at the South Connection slot: "not validated by a commanding officer". Found the Commander's Quarters east of the office (missed it on day 1!): a HyperSecurity safe (8000 settings, 12–20 numbers in the combo) and a log tape, "Commander's Log 11349.12.2–12.4". Taking it to the log reader.

### Commands 276-298
The log tape was a jackpot. Fuel cells were hidden in the Dome storage bin and the bin key is in the safe; a Shady Dan in the village sells modified ID cards; the village is off-limits and forms aren't being validated; the stamp is hidden under the Commander's bed; the pyramid was moved to the holding tank (now blasted open!); there were gym and laundry breakdowns; the hull welders are malfunctioning; and the log readers are overheating... "What the krip!". Looked under the Commander's bed: validation stamp! Validated the ironed village form. Then the log reader EXPLODED (a black scar where it was). Saved (3 slots; replaced the oldest).

### Commands 299-318
The validated form opened the South Connection iris hatch halfway: +6 (score 17). The village is ZERO-G and deserted. Grimy Passage → Main Street (exits W, NE, S, SE, up, down). Travel Agency (posters). Bank: took a platinum detector (on, nothing yet); dropped the stamp there. Greasy Straw restaurant: a cup of Ramosian Fire Nectar behind the counter (took it). Trading Post: its sign advertises FREZONE explosive; an instruction sheet says insert the explosive in a hole, attach a detonator and TIMER, set the timer, vamoose, and keep it below 150 K. There's also a twelve-prong fromitz board (left it). Grocery: a plastic bag of vacuum taffy (possible food). So the plan is drill + explosive + detonator (needs a diode) + timer (PX, needs a coin).

### Commands 319-343
Broadway hub: Recruitment Office (posters), Rec Shop (simulation booths, off), Field Office (took a HEADLAMP, wore it; I keep it off to save power; dropped the bedistor there), Makeshift Connector W (the back side of the East Connection iris hatch). Barbershop SE: the platinum detector BEEPS here. The mirror is fixed to the wall and "the point of the drill doesn't seem as hard as the mirror". Theory: platinum behind the mirror/wall, needing explosive in a drilled hole... but nothing drills. Ate the blue soup (hunger reset to ~320).

### Commands 344-362
Pet Store: an Arcturian balloon creature (hydrogen-filled, "useless buoyancy in zero-gee"). Opened the cage. Grabbing the leash makes it FART in my face and I drop everything (lol). It happened twice; I can't hold the leash in zero-g. Theory: in gravity it floats, so it could lift something toward the chapel star? Fortune Teller under Broadway: the crystal ball holds fortune-teller "tips" (joke). Broadway NW: "ALMOST every direction" (joke). Saloon: deserted, with a disguised exit east → Casino (roulette wheel, dice). The detector "is getting warm" in the Casino — dropped it there, fearing it would explode like the log reader.

### Commands 363-377
Casino: took the dice (nothing noteworthy). Studio (west of the Trading Post; the arrival printed a "Junk Yard" line before the Studio heading): a scrap sculpture with a J-series hyperdiode! Swapped it into the detonator and dropped the blackened one there. Shady Dan's (SE of the Trading Post): an "innocuous machine". Turned it on, put in my ID card: "Current rank is 6". Typed 9: "New rank is 9: HyperAdmiral" lol. Took the card back. It should now open the security doors (Sick Bay east, End of Corridor north on Level Six). No points for either yet.

### Commands 378-398
Junk Yard (below Shady Dan's): magnetic boots. The game WARNED me they would wipe my ID card — nice guard rail, so I left them. Alley hub: Missionary N (a doomsday kook, nothing), Warehouse NE (a sign, "TRADING POST VACUUM STORAGE AREA", over an airlock going down; the lower door is stencilled "SECURE ALL OPEN CONTAINERS BEFORE DEPRESSURIZATION"). Stepped into the airlock and back out — no suit. Saved at the Warehouse. Loan Shark S: a strong box with an "asteroid-sized" lock (explosive target?). Doc Schuster's SE: an ostrich (Floyd: "Wow! An elephant!"), a disposal hole in the wall, and a letter: "ostrich nip... in my ceiling panel". A welder (#3) showed up in the Alley.

### Commands 399-400
Pawn Shop (Alley SW): an E-Z SPRAY SPORZ can ("lowest gas-inducement"). Sprayed it in the Pet Store (the balloon creature gobbles the spores), but grabbing the leash still ends in a fart, and now the game adds "Perhaps it would behave differently somewhere with gravity." Take all got everything back. Leg over at 400 commands, score 17/80, standing in the Pet Store, day 2, time 5389.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- **Duffy (start ship):** Deck Twelve (door port, slot) – aft Forms Storage – starboard Cargo Bay Entrance – fore Robot Pool (Floyd = bin 3) / starboard Cargo Bay (spacetruck).
- **Station, Level 5 (lobby, ladder up/down, elevator E):** W Docking Bay #2 (my truck); N Workshop → N Storage (DARK) ; NE North Junction → E Sick Bay (security door E + ID reader), NE PX (vending machine: 6 Timer, 9 Large Drill Bit, 1 galakmid each), N North Connection (W = Storage, dark) → N Tube → Sci Sub-Module [Engineering Lab/Office, up Astro Lab/Office, up Scientists' Quarters; down Bio Lab/Office, down Holding Tank (blasted open)]; SE East Junction → E East Connection (iris hatch, military; S Comm Center; SW Station Control) ; SE South Junction → SW File Room (DARK), SE Commander's Office → E Commander's Quarters (safe, bed), S Briefing Room → W South Connection (iris hatch S = village, now half-open) → W Robot Shop (Oliver, heating chamber).
- **Level 4:** Female/Male Barracks, SanFac, W Docking Bay #3.
- **Level 3:** Gym (exercise machine, freq-710 sign), Theatre (locked projection booth), Laundry (presser), Chapel (flame switch in pulpit, blinking star out of reach).
- **Level 2:** Mess Hall (acid-spitting FDU, coffee), Main Storage, Meeting Rooms 1–2, Library (nanofilm reader, lilac + puce spools there).
- **Level 1 / top:** Dome (locked storage bin = fuel cells; air shaft grating).
- **Level 6:** Aux Barracks+SanFac, Officers' Qtrs A/B/C+SanFac, End of Corridor (security door N + ID reader; E Shipping Room DARK), NW Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: dots, skeleton, empty pedestal), SW Docking Bay #4.
- **Level 7:** Printing Plant (trash can) → NW Paper Recycling (fromitz board 20-prong left here). Ladder to Level 8 sealed; elevator refuses 8.
- **Village (zero-G, via South Connection):** Grimy Passage – Main Street (W Travel Agency → SE Bank [stamp left here]; NE Greasy Straw → NE Trading Post; SE/Up/Down → Alley). Trading Post: N Grocery (taffy) → N Broadway [N Recruitment, NE Rec Shop, E Field Office (bedistor left), W Makeshift Connector (back of East Connection hatch), SE Barbershop (platinum detector beeps; mirror), SW Pet Store, Down Fortune Teller]; E Saloon → E Casino (platinum detector left here, dice); W Studio; SE Shady Dan's (ID rank machine) → Down Junk Yard (magnetic boots) → W Alley [N Missionary, NE Warehouse (airlock down to vacuum storage), S Loan Shark (strong box), SE Doc Schuster's (ostrich, letter, disposal hole), SW Pawn Shop (mauve spool left)].

### Puzzles solved
- Robot form in Robot Pool slot, type 3 → Floyd.
- Spacetruck: close hatch BEFORE sitting, sit pilot seat (Floyd copilot), form in slot, course = Assignment form table for current time (+5 on docking).
- Floyd fetches medium drill bit from heating chamber (+3).
- Sleep in a bed when tired (+3).
- Crumpled village entry form → Laundry presser (open/put/close/turn on/off/open) → validate with stamp from under Commander's bed → South Connection slot (+6).
- Log tape (Commander's Quarters desk) in office log reader: many clues (reader then exploded).
- J-series hyperdiode from Studio sculpture swapped into detonator (no points yet).
- ID card upgraded to rank 9 "HyperAdmiral" at Shady Dan's machine (not yet tried on a security door).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Security doors** (Sick Bay E, Level 6 End of Corridor N): try the rank-9 ID card now.
- **Chapel star** (a hyperdiode inside, out of reach) – maybe no longer needed since I got the Studio diode.
- **Balloon creature**: can't be leashed in zero-G; the game hints "somewhere with gravity". Maybe spray spores/lead it back into the station; its hydrogen lift could reach the chapel star or be a use elsewhere.
- **Explosive plan**: FREZONE at the Trading Post ("ask for it"/vacuum storage below the Warehouse airlock; must stay under 150 K, so maybe carried in the Thermos). Hole via drill (needs Large Drill Bit from the PX — needs a coin; the strong box in the Loan Shark likely holds money) + detonator (fixed) + timer (PX item 6). Targets: the strong box, the theatre booth lock, the Barbershop mirror (platinum)?
- **Safe** in Commander's Quarters (8000-setting dial, 12–20 numbers) holds the Dome bin key → fuel cells (needed for the truck home).
- **Alien dots** (taste message) need translating — the "mayor, a linguist" per Schmidt's diary.
- **Dark rooms**: Storage (Lvl 5), File Room, Shipping Room — the headlamp (worn, off) now solves this.
- Ostrich nip in some "ceiling panel"; ostrich in Doc's; magnetic boots (wipe ID cards!); nectar; vacuum taffy.
- Level 8 is sealed from below — probably where the pyramid went.

### What I would try next
1. Go back to the station and use the rank-9 card on the Sick Bay security door and the Level 6 End of Corridor door.
2. Light the headlamp and explore the File Room / Storage / Shipping Room.

## Leg 4 handoff (session END: the 1,500-command cap is spent)

**Where I ended:** Chapel, DAY 2, time ~7158, **score 50/80 (best of the whole session)**. Not won. Hungry in ~14 (the first stage). NO FOOD carried: the taffy is still on the Grocery shelf and the fire nectar is somewhere in the Greasy Straw ("a whiff of something mouth-watering"). Sleepy in ~50 (the sleep +3 was already taken on day 1→2).
**Saves:** Chapel day 2 (50) [newest], Gym day 2 (50), Warehouse day 2 (50).
**Carrying:** reflective foil (platinum), M-series hyperdiode, ID card (rank 9), headlamp (worn, dimming), drill (small bit; ONE hole left, save it for the Commander's safe), zapgun (4 shots used: welders #1, #3, #4, and the bin), survival kit (medium bit, nip, empty Thermos), Assignment form (validated, in the uniform pocket).
**Item locations:** jammer (on, 710, with the 20-prong board) in the Gym. 12-prong board in Level 5 Storage. Space suit, magnetic boots, detonator (J-series diode fitted) in the Flophouse. Platinum detector in the Gym (Floyd dropped it). Explosive still in the vac yard. Stamp in Main Storage. Spray can, leash and balloon creature in the Chapel (flame OFF). Ostrich last seen at the Casino/Warehouse area. Floyd is alive and increasingly nasty; Plato is dead.

### Map (additions this leg)
- Level 6 End of Corridor S → Officers' Quarters C → SW Officers SanFac → N Officers' Quarters B (personal items only).
- Level 5 North Connection W → Storage (dark; jammer); N → Tube → Engineering Lab (N Engineering Office: Schmidt's diary, desk; Up Astro Lab (20-prong board), N Astro Office; Up Scientists' Quarters (bed, cubicles)).
- South Connection E → Briefing Room → N Commander's Office (LOG READER, no tape) → N Station Control (monitor board) → NE East Connection.
- Mess Hall SE → Library (the terminal is removed) → N Meeting Room 2 → N Meeting Room 1 → W Mess Hall.
- Broadway NW and Alley W are "special" no-exit jokes.

### Puzzles solved (full list for this game, score 50)
Floyd (+0), truck launch and dock (+5), validated form → South Connection (+6), medium bit via Floyd (+3), mirror → foil (+4), Pet Store ceiling → nip (+3), roulette (+4), sleep (+3), balloon creature → Chapel star → M-series diode (+7), Armory (+5), Plato ambush (+7: on day 2 this time, on Broadway; tell Floyd anything four times), vac yard (+3: suit + magnetic boots + closed kit + no ID card).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **COIN for the PX** (item 6 timer / 9 large bit): still unsolved. This leg ruled out: the officers' quarters, Scientists'/Astro/Engineering offices, the alley garbage, the dice ("You roll a 7"), a platinum-detector sweep of the Casino, and the OSTRICH: scaring it makes it stick its head into any hole (the Doc's disposal hole and the PX dispenser hole), but nothing came out. - **Jammer at 710**: left on in the Gym. The machine stays put so far; its purpose is unproven.
- The **log reader** in the Commander's Office needs the log tape (I remember a log tape from leg 1 but not where).

2. Coin: scare the ostrich at the PX right after typing 6 or 9 on the keypad, or with Floyd told to reach in at the same time; try the theatre booth lock/seats with the ostrich; look for the log tape and play it for hints.

# Playtest diary: r8-click-fullB

- **Mode:** click

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmd 0.** Session created. Deck Twelve, score 0, time 5101. I carry uniform+ID card, chronometer, three forms. Door to port with a slot beside it. Old Zork habits: read everything, examine everything. Plan: read forms, try ID card in slot.

**Cmds 1-12.** Read the green Activation Form (paper viewer image, nice). ID card in the Deck Twelve slot is just spat back; port door stays shut. Aft = Forms Storage Room (boxes; a scenery 'form' with an EMPTY menu, filed). Starboard = Cargo Bay Entrance; fore = Robot Pool with Rex, Helen, and Floyd in bin 3 (Floyd reveal, lovely). Put Robot Use Authorization form in slot, typed 3 on keypad: Floyd hugs me. Score still 0. Next: cargo bay, probably a spacetruck needing the Activation Form.

**Cmds 13-25.** Cargo bay spacetruck: opened hatch, went in, took survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos). Form refused until both seats filled; I sat in pilot seat and Floyd took copilot. Then I could not close the hatch from the seat. Activated anyway, read course table on Assignment form (time:course), waited (a WAIT is ~40 time units!), typed 259 at 5388, launch... died, air out the open hatch. My own fault; restart. Lesson: close hatch BEFORE sitting, and SAVE (costs no time).

**Cmds 26-42.** Replayed after restart (start time is randomised: 4952 this time). Robot form, bin 3, Floyd. Took kit, CLOSED hatch while standing, then sat. Activated, saved (Floyd: 'are we gonna try something dangerous?' - cute). At 5111 typed 328 per table. Launch OK. Waits now jump ~240 time units in flight. Fuel three-quarters. Examined the ostrich: 'half its height is its neck' - so it can reach into the PX hole. Holding the nip, the ostrich follows me (it does a comic bellyflop when it enters gravity). The space suit is too bulky for the iris hatches; I dropped it in the Makeshift Connector. At the PX, put the nip in the hole: the ostrich pulls out the stuck TIMER, +6 (61), then gets drunk on the nip. Bad news: at East Connection, 'even sealed in the Thermos, the explosive is getting softer'. Drilled the safe with the MEDIUM bit (pencil diameter, same as the explosive; the small bit is toothpick-sized), explosive in hole +3 (64), connected the detonator... and the explosive SUBLIMED; the game says it's now unwinnable. Retried from the save: same turn. It's a fixed melt clock (~40 turns after leaving the vac yard).

**Cmds 76-105.** Restored 'Flophouse' (49) and replanned: do everything first, then make the explosive run last and fast. Nip again (+3, 52), suit + jammer left in the Warehouse by the airlock. Ostrich via Grimy Passage/South Connection (suit off, so it fits). The ostrich refuses to enter the Commander's Quarters ('bad experience with a bed in its youth' - lol). Drilled the safe (medium bit) in advance; left the drill, detonator and ID card there. PX: nip in hole, timer +6 (58). Saved 'The PX' (58). Next: connect the detonator to the timer in the Quarters, fetch the boots, and do the vac-yard run via Alley-Main St-Grimy-South Connection (~15 turns).

**Cmds 106-170.** Connected the timer to the detonator in the Quarters, then the boots from the Junk Yard, and the suit from the Warehouse. Vac yard (+3, 61): explosive in the Thermos, then straight back via Alley-Main St-Grimy-South Connection-South Junction-Office-Quarters (~15 turns). Saved 'Commander's Quarters' (61). Explosive in hole (+3, 64), connected, took the ID card (boots off first), set the timer to 5, left: it melted silently. Restored and did it tighter with the timer at 2: NO explosion, and the room list showed the detonator EMPTY. The J-series hyperdiode had vanished without any message. Put the M-series (chapel star) diode in, set 2, went west: 'deafening explosion'. Safe blown open: KEY +7, score 71. Saved 'Commander's Quarters' (71). Filed high: the J diode vanished silently. Next: the key -> Dome storage bin -> fuel cells.

**Cmds 171-230.** Level Three lights went out (lamp on). Dome: unlocked the bin with the key, opened it: the FUEL CELLS EXPLODED (sabotage), knocking me out. I woke well-fed and well-rested (Diagnose no longer shows counters), and the AIR SHAFT GRATING is now loose. Bent it open, entered: Top of Air Shaft +2 (73). PA: 'Prepare for launch of second-generation pyramids. Station will be eliminated by reactor overload immediately following launch.' Endgame! The headlamp DIED in the shaft; at the Bottom, in the dark, the floor grating wasn't listed, so I couldn't open it (filed high). Restored Dome, climbed down with the lamp OFF, lit it at the Bottom, opened the grating: fell into COMPUTER CONTROL (below Level Eight; ladder up, elevator N). The EXERCISE MACHINE was waiting ('No pain, no gain!'). 'Launch in 200 millichrons.' The zapgun did nothing; it blocked the ladder and killed me (death). Need the 710 jammer (left in the Warehouse).

**Cmds 231-313.** Tried to rescue the endgame. From the Computer Control save: pushing the elevator call button = 'nothing happens'; 'Get in' the exercise machine = exercised to death. Restored the Dome and walked dark to the Warehouse. Lamp on, took the jammer (still ON at 710), lamp off, saved 'Warehouse' (71). Walked dark back to the Dome and lit the lamp to see the grating. It died on entering the shaft, so lamp life is time-based while lit and on/off turns count. Climbing down in the dark, the pyramids launched and the reactor went H-bomb: death. The countdown starts when the fuel cells blow, and the jammer round trip (~25 turns) is too long. Every save I hold is after the blast with a nearly dead lamp, so this game is unwinnable. Per the rules I'm restarting the checkpoint (game start).

**Replay after restart (leg cmds ~314-365).** Fresh game (time 4626). Robot form + bin 3 = Floyd. Took the kit, CLOSED the hatch, sat; Floyd took the copilot seat. Activation form; the time was 4801, so course 427 from the table (Assignment form image). Docked, +5. Ate the orange goo. REMEMBER: the Thermos holds BLUE SOUP (food). Saved 'Docking Bay #2' (score 5). Stamp from under the Commander's bed; Floyd wandered off exploring. Printing Plant trash -> crumpled form, validated it with the stamp (the 'Validate…' menu entry is nice). Took the drill from Paper Recycling. Heading to the Laundry presser.

**Replay, leg cmds 366-400.** Ironed the form in the Laundry presser; the South Connection slot opened the hatch (+6, 11). Floyd and Plato showed up; told Floyd to take the medium bit from the heating chamber (+3, 14). Village: broke the Barbershop mirror, took the foil (+4, 18). Took the headlamp from the Field Office and left it OFF. Examining it gives no hint of battery life. The Makeshift Connector hatch is already open in this game (it is W of Broadway). Leg ended there.

## Leg 3 handoff

**Best score: 73/80** (the first game, now dead). **Current game (restarted): score 18, Makeshift Connector, day 1, time 7051.** Saves: 'Field Office, day 1, score 18' (newest), 'Barbershop 18', 'Robot Shop 14'.
Carrying: headlamp (OFF, full charge), reflective foil, medium bit, drill (small bit, 2 holes? unknown), stamp, kit (gray goo + Thermos of BLUE SOUP = food), ID card, Assignment form. Floyd + Plato following.

### Map (additions this leg)
- Pet Store: hidden CEILING PANEL (examine ceiling), holding the ostrich nip.
- The Dome bin, once opened, blasts the fuel cells and loosens the AIR SHAFT GRATING. Dome grating -> Top of Air Shaft -> Air Shaft x5 -> Bottom of Air Shaft (floor grating; lateral ducts too small) -> COMPUTER CONTROL (ladder up to Level Eight; elevator N; exercise machine lurking).
- The Grimy Passage and Makeshift Connector iris hatches are too narrow for a worn space suit (carry it, or drop it).

### Solved this leg (the full chain, in order)
1. Ostrich nip: Pet Store ceiling panel (+3). The ostrich follows the nip (it won't enter rooms with beds). Put the nip in the PX dispenser hole: the ostrich pulls out the stuck TIMER (+6). You need a coin in the slot plus typing 6 first (the strong box coin).
2. Safe: drill ONE hole with the MEDIUM bit (pencil diameter; small = toothpick). Leave the detonator + timer (connected to each other) in the Commander's Quarters BEFORE fetching the explosive.
3. The detonator needs the **M-series hyperdiode** (chapel star). The J-series (Studio sculpture) silently burns out: no boom and no message.
4. Explosive: vac yard (suit + boots; drop the ID card first because the boots wipe it). Open the Thermos IN SPACE, put the explosive in, close it. It melts about 40 turns after leaving the vacuum, and only a few turns once out of the Thermos. Fast route: Airlock-Warehouse-Alley-Main St-Grimy-South Connection-South Junction-Office-Quarters.
5. Explosive in the hole (+3), connect the detonator, set the timer to 2, go W: boom. Key (+7).
6. Key in the Dome bin: the fuel cells EXPLODE (sabotage) and the station lights go out everywhere. An endgame countdown starts (PA: pyramid launch, then reactor overload); it runs roughly 25-30 turns. Top of Air Shaft (+2).

### Why the first game died
The headlamp was nearly spent from leg-2 exploring. The lights go out at the endgame, the Dome and shaft bottom are dark, and in click mode unseen objects (the floor grating) can't be opened. The exercise machine in Computer Control kills you unless you carry the 710 JAMMER (the zapgun doesn't work on it). Fetching the jammer after the blast takes too long for the countdown.

### What to do next (current game)
Replay leg-2 solutions WITHOUT using the lamp (skip dark Storage except to grab the JAMMER: 1-2 lit turns only; fromitz board from Paper Recycling; set 710 and ON). Order: village map (Mayor optional), Shady Dan rank 10 (armory zapgun, needed for the strong box coin), coin, balloon creature + spores -> chapel star M-diode, Studio J-diode for the detonator (from Main Storage) only as a placeholder, roulette -> Flophouse suit, boots, nip + ostrich + timer, safe prep, explosive run, key. BEFORE opening the Dome bin: carry the jammer (ON, 710), foil, and a lamp with charge. Then: Dome bin -> grating (lamp on) -> climb dark -> lamp on at the Bottom -> open the grating -> Computer Control -> Level Eight (ladder up) with the foil vs pyramid. Eat the soup, the gray goo, the taffy and the Fire Nectar; NEVER the coffee.

## Leg 4

**Leg 4 start.** 300 commands left of the 1500 cap (leg budget says 400, cap wins). Makeshift Connector, score 18, day 1. Plan, in order: Shady Dan rank 10 -> Armory zapgun -> strong box coin; nip + ostrich; spores + balloon -> chapel M-diode; roulette -> suit; jammer (Storage, lamp briefly) + fromitz board; timer; safe; explosive run; key; endgame with the jammer, foil and a fresh lamp.

**Leg 4, cmds 1-55.** Shady Dan's: machine on, ID in slot, keypad 10 -> HyperAdmiral (welder #2 came at me; left). Dropped the stamp in the Trading Post. On the way past, pre-drilled the Commander's safe with the medium bit (the drill menu closes after the first 'one hole left' warning; reopening with "746 Drill…" worked; I wasted 2 commands on stale option numbers). Left the drill + small bit in the Quarters. Level Six End of Corridor: rank-10 ID -> Armory +5 (23), zapgun. My mistake: went to Paper Recycling for the fromitz board, but in this replay it's still in the Astro Lab. Jammer from dark Storage (lamp on for 2 turns), board from the Astro Lab, put in the jammer, set to 710 (jammer still OFF). Sleepy in ~28.

**Cmds 56-96.** Slept in the Scientists' Quarters (had to Get in bed, Wait until tired, Sleep, Wait): Day 2, +3 (26); 'Take all' after waking tries to lift Floyd again (still funny). Walked to the village: Broadway SW = Pet Store (new route!). Opened the ceiling panel (nip visible, left it there for now). Dropped the Assignment form. Shady Dan's Down = Junk Yard, W = Alley. Shot the strong box: coin +5 (31). Ate the gray goo at the growl. Examined Doc's letter WITHOUT the robots present: no betrayal this time (so it must need Plato in the room, or a timer). Pawn Shop spray can. Saved 'Pawn Shop' (31).

**Cmds 97-132.** Took the nip (+3, 34), put the coin in my uniform. Opened the cage and herded the balloon creature with spores: Trading Post, Greasy Straw, Main St, Grimy, South Connection (gravity), South Junction, Level Five, Four, Three: one move plus one spray per room, flawless this time. Chapel: pulpit switch off, spray, take leash (float), open star: M-series hyperdiode +7 (41). Dropped the spray can in the Chapel. Plato still hasn't betrayed me. Next: detonator (Main Storage, L2), then the PX timer via the ostrich.

**Cmds 133-160.** Climbed to the Mess Hall: PLATO'S BETRAYAL fired there (time ~2661, day 2), not at Doc's letter. I only pressed Wait through the monologue; on the 4th turn Floyd burst into tears and ran, and Plato killed me. Last game I had been giving Floyd orders, and that is what let Floyd save me. Restored 'Pawn Shop' (31) and replayed nip (+3), cage, and spore-herding to South Connection. When Plato strikes again I'll issue Floyd orders every turn.

**Cmds 161-182.** Rehearded the balloon (+7 again, 41), saved 'Chapel' (41). Mess Hall: Plato struck at time ~2654. While I was paralysed, 'Tell Floyd to…' grew new entries (Save you, Turn off Plato, Take… with the stun ray in the list). Floyd was 'in quandry' for three turns; on the 4th ('take ray') he knocked the gun away and Plato blew up: +7 (48). So ORDERS are needed; passive waiting = death. Main Storage: detonator opened, blackened diode out, M-series in; carrying the detonator. 118 commands left of the cap. Next: ostrich + timer.
**Cmds 183-196.** Down to L5, S through South Connection to the village, Doc's: the ostrich sniffs the nip and follows me (a lovely 'between swimming and flying' line, then a bellyflop in gravity). Heading to the PX.
**Cmds 197-212.** PX: coin in slot, typed 6 (klunk), nip in the hole: the ostrich yanks out the TIMER and passes out drunk, +6 (54). Connected the detonator to the timer. ~88 commands left.
**Cmds 213-227.** Saved 'The PX' (54). Left the detonator+timer in the Commander's Quarters next to the drilled safe. Now to Casino -> Flophouse for the suit, then the boots, then the vac yard.
**Cmds 228-241.** Casino: turned the roulette wheel +4 (58). Flophouse locker: space suit. 'Take suit' was refused for weight, with a helpful hint naming what to drop; I WORE the headlamp instead (worn items are free), then took the suit. Dropped the ID card in the Flophouse (boots next). ~59 left.
**Cmds 242-252.** Wore the suit (fine through the village connectors), took and wore the boots in the Junk Yard, reached the Warehouse. Floyd wandered off exploring. ~48 left: vac-yard run next.
**Cmds 253-271.** Airlock sequence clean (inner open, down, inner close, outer open, down): vac yard +3 (61). Lamp on, opened the Thermos (soup boils away, known), explosive in, closed, lamp off, back up and out. Took the suit off on Main Street (it won't fit the iris hatch when worn). Rushing to the safe.

**Cmds 272-275 (harness).** The CARRIED suit is also too bulky for the Grimy Passage hatch (my leg-3 note was wrong); dropped it there. Quarters: open Thermos, explosive in hole +3 (64), connect detonator to explosive (footnote 13), timer 2, W: deafening explosion. Take all skipped the key in the open safe; took it directly: KEY +7, score 71. 25 commands left. Heading for the Dome.
**Cmds 276-290.** Saved 'Commander's Quarters' (71). The station lights went out on leaving the Quarters with the key (last game: only after the bin). Walked dark to the Dome, lamp on, unlocked the bin, jammer ON (710), opened the bin: the fuel cells exploded, I was knocked out, and everything dropped; the grating is now loose. ~10 commands left.

**Cmds 291-300 (cap).** Took the jammer and foil, bent the grating open, entered: Top of Air Shaft +2 (73, equals my best). PA: pyramid launch, then reactor overload. Climbed down 7 times with the lamp ON (the fresh lamp lasted fine), opened the floor grating and fell into COMPUTER CONTROL. The 710 jammer worked: 'The exercise machine experiences a series of mechanical spasms and then freezes.' Then a huge grime-covered FORKLIFT (the one missing from the Shipping Room!) descended from the ladder hole and settled between the machine's arms, smoking like an angry bull. PA: 'Launch in 200 millichrons.' Used the last command to save ('Computer Control', score 73). 1500/1500 cap reached.

## Leg 4 handoff (final: cap reached)

**Best score: 73/80**, reached twice (game 1, and this game). **Ended in Computer Control, day 2, score 73. Not won.** Newest save: 'Computer Control, day 2, score 73' (lamp ON, jammer ON at 710, foil held, boots worn; exercise machine frozen; forklift just arrived; launch in 200 millichrons). Other saves: 'Commander's Quarters 71' (key in hand, before the Dome), 'The PX 54'.

### Map (additions)
- Broadway SW = Pet Store. Shady Dan's Down = Junk Yard, Junk Yard W = Alley. Air shaft: Dome grating -> Top -> 6x Air Shaft -> Bottom -> floor grating -> Computer Control (ladder up to Level Eight, elevator N).

### Puzzles solved, fastest known order (this game, ~290 commands from score 18)
Shady Dan rank 10 -> Armory (+5, zapgun) -> pre-drill the safe with the MEDIUM bit -> jammer (dark Storage) + twenty-prong board (Astro Lab), set 710 -> sleep (+3) -> zap the strong box (coin +5) -> nip from the Pet Store ceiling panel (+3) -> open the cage and spore-herd the balloon to the Chapel (flame off, leash, star: M-diode +7) -> PLATO ambush in the Mess Hall at about time 2650 on day 2: while paralysed, give Floyd orders every turn (Tell Floyd to... Take... stun ray); passive waiting is fatal (+7) -> detonator from Main Storage, M-diode in -> ostrich follows the nip to the PX, coin, 6, nip in the hole: timer (+6) -> connect the timer to the detonator, leave both in the Quarters -> roulette (+4) -> Flophouse suit (wear the headlamp to free a hand) -> boots -> airlock -> vac yard (+3), explosive in the Thermos -> DROP the suit before the Grimy Passage hatch (carried is too bulky too) -> explosive in the hole (+3), connect it, timer 2, go W -> key (+7; 'Take all' won't take it from the safe) -> lights die -> Dome: jammer ON, unlock and open the bin (you're knocked out and drop everything; retake the jammer and foil) -> grating (+2) -> down 7 -> open the floor grating -> Computer Control: the jammer freezes the exercise machine.

### Open puzzle and theories
- **The forklift** in Computer Control is the pyramid's last defender. Theories: jam it too (try other jammer frequencies? the gym sign said 710 is the machine's diagnostic frequency; maybe the forklift has its own), climb/board it, or go UP the ladder to Level Eight (the pyramid factory) and hold up the REFLECTIVE FOIL (element 78) against the pyramid's radiation. Floyd may matter at the end (he has been growing surly under the pyramid's influence).
- Countdown: about 200 millichrons of launch remain; act at once.

### What I'd try next
Restore 'Computer Control'. Examine the forklift; try 'Up' (the ladder to Level Eight) immediately; at the pyramid, use the foil ('Put it on…'/'Show'/'Hold'). If the forklift blocks, try Shoot... (the zapgun was left in the Dome), or reset the jammer frequency.

# Playtest round 8: triage

**Draft for Norm, written by hand by his delegate on 2026-09-27. It is not yet in the registry.** The registry, the queue and the code are unchanged. Issue ids from SF-178 on are provisional: they are the ids `add` would give, in this order. Once Norm has run `add`, `link` and `confirm` for these rows, `node scripts/playtest-registry.mjs report 8` regenerates this file in the round-7 format, and the regenerated file replaces this one (rule 10). The tier in "Norm confirms" is the delegate's proposal, checked against the ZIL and the oracle as each Evidence cell says.

Round 8 was three full runs from the opening to the 1,500-command cap (4,500 commands) with UNDO off (D18, D29). None was won. ## What UNDO off changed

Round 8 had 29 deaths by the `died` flag (8, 8 and 13), 44 restores and 5 restarts. The testers called deaths "fair" much as in round 7. What changed is the cost, and so what they filed:
- **Fast, informed deaths drew rows again.** The hatch (3), the airlock (4), the coffee (3), the elevator (2) and the beacon button (1) were filed as "blocked" or "stings with UNDO off". In round 7 these were undone and hardly filed. They stay C under D28 item 4.
